title: Payment milestone schedule crossing a page, one row split by the page break
row_rules: One row per milestone. Milestone 5's payment trigger starts at the foot of page 1 and finishes at the top of page 2: it is one cell. The repeated header and the Total line are not rows.
why: The schedule starts low on page 1, so milestone 5 (Envelope) is split by the page break: the first lines of its payment trigger are on page 1 and the rest continue on page 2, under the repeated header, in a row whose other cells are empty. The running header and the page footer fall between the two halves in a text dump.
